mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, directly boosting corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases month-over-month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% (CPIAUCSL) triggers market anticipation of aggressive Fed tightening, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% YoY, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand acceleration, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS increase month-over-month, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), tight labor markets generate wage pressures and inflationary expectations, prompting preemptive Fed tightening that reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE is below 4.0%, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strong manufacturing activity and economic momentum, directly supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases month-over-month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in payroll employment exceeding 50,000 (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering economic slowdown fears and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where PAYEMS declines by more than 50k, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), restrictive monetary policy compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, supporting sustained corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% quarterly, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
